title: Grandma Has a Proverb for Everything
logline: Whatever goes wrong, my grandmother has a proverb ready, and in the end the whole family sits together over her coffee.
audience: My family and friends, watching on their phones
intent: They should laugh and recognise their own grandmother in her proverb for every situation, then feel warm about sitting together over coffee.
